zh: 已保存行程的详情在系统导航和底栏之间滚动，底部站点可继续向上翻看。详情页可以直接从底栏切回聊天。
记忆页可以查看当前对话尚未确认的建议。选择要记住的内容时，可切回聊天确认。
提高了 iOS 26.5 已保存行程的日期按钮对比度。分段、多选探索中，提醒来源可长按查看。
en: Saved itinerary details scroll between the system navigation and tab bars. Scroll to read the last stop, or use the bottom tab to return to Chat.
The Memory tab shows suggestions from the current chat while they await confirmation. Return to Chat to choose what to remember.
Saved itinerary date buttons have improved contrast on iOS 26.5. In multiple-choice exploration, touch and hold a reminder to see its sources.

zh: 与构建 47 相比，行程详情更好读，记忆方格上方显示待确认建议，聊天中的探索提醒只显示结果。
en: Compared with build 47, saved itineraries are easier to read, suggestions appear above the memory tiles, and exploration reminders show only the result in chat.

zh: ① 在已有对话留一段未发送的草稿，强制关闭再打开 App，确认同一对话、消息与草稿都恢复。② 新建对话，问“北京是中国的首都吗？”，等到完整回答。
③ 从历史列表分别打开之前的对话和第 ② 项新对话。④ 在第 ② 项对话留草稿，锁屏或切后台 10 秒再返回，核对同一对话和草稿。
⑤ 问“你是谁”，查看首条回答。⑥ 问“你能做啥”，查看能力说明。⑦ 问“北京三日游”，核对第 1 至第 3 天都有具体安排。第 ⑤ 至 ⑦ 项分别从新对话开始。
每项记下大概时间。遇到失败请截图，在“问题记录”里点“复制”，提供已有记录并暂停本轮。保留当前账号、消息和草稿。
en: ① Leave an unsent draft in an existing chat. Force-quit and reopen the app, then check that the same chat, messages and draft return. ② Start a new chat, ask “Is Beijing the capital of China?” and wait for a complete reply.

③ Open both the original chat and the new chat from step ② in History. ④ Leave an unsent draft in the chat from step ②. Lock the screen or background the app for 10 seconds. Verify the same chat and draft on return.

⑤ Ask “Who are you?” and check the first reply. ⑥ Ask “What can you do?” and check the capabilities. ⑦ Ask “A three-day trip to Beijing” and check for concrete plans for days 1–3. Use a fresh chat for each of steps ⑤–⑦.

Note the approximate time for each step. If something fails, take a screenshot and tap Copy in Problem notes to share any existing record, then pause the test. Keep your current account, messages and drafts.

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

zh: 本轮只检查一次简单北京规划，确认有完整三天安排。
行程正式保存、修改与撤销，以及全国规划仍在验证。
“记住”偏好仍需单独完成真实验收。
本轮使用系统默认字号。较大字号下仍有卡片显示或切日问题。
分段、多选探索尚未默认开启；真机弱网和锁屏至少 5 分钟的恢复仍待单独验证。
行程详情和日期按钮已完成模拟器检查，仍待真机确认。
en: For planning, this check covers one simple Beijing request and a complete three-day itinerary.
Formal itinerary saving, edits and undo, and planning across China are still being validated.
Remember preferences still requires a separate live check.
Use the system default text size. Card display or day selection can still have issues at larger sizes.
Segmented, multiple-choice exploration is not the default. Weak-network and lock-screen recovery after at least five minutes still need separate device checks.
Saved itinerary details and date buttons passed simulator checks and still need confirmation on a device.

zh: 配套香港服务改善了规划等待时查看对话的体验。服务端调整部署后自动生效，构建 47 也可使用这项服务改进。
en: The accompanying Hong Kong service changes improve chat loading while a plan is in progress. Service changes take effect after deployment. Build 47 can also use this service improvement.

zh: 对话行程卡默认显示第一天，每次预览一天，最多显示四项并标出其余数量。点“查看”可打开完整行程。
登录页按钮的文字可随系统字号调整，按钮全宽可点。
改善历史页标题、底栏未选中标签和图标，以及深色空行程页面按钮的可读性。
问题记录现在区分系统取消和网络故障。已受理的回答遇到服务不可用或限额时，可打开已有问题记录。
en: Chat itinerary cards start on day one. Preview one day at a time with up to four stops and a remaining count. Tap View for the full itinerary.
Sign-in buttons use scalable text and can be tapped across their full width.
Improve readability of chat history titles, inactive tab labels and icons, and the button on the empty Trips page in dark mode.
Problem notes now distinguish cancellation from network errors. If an accepted reply fails due to service availability or a limit, you can open existing problem notes.

zh: 与构建 46 相比，逐日展开改为单日预览，深色模式下卡片站点文字更清楚。
构建 47 也改善了登录、历史和底栏的显示，以及回答失败后的提示。
en: Compared with build 46, cards preview a single day instead of expanding every day. Stop text is easier to read in dark mode.
Build 47 also improves sign-in, history and tab presentation and guides you to problem notes after an accepted reply fails.

zh: ① 在已有对话留一段未发送的草稿，强制关闭再打开 App，确认同一对话、消息与草稿都恢复。② 新建对话，问“北京是中国的首都吗？”，等到完整回答。
③ 从历史列表分别打开之前的对话和第 ② 项新对话。④ 在第 ② 项对话留草稿，切后台 10 秒后返回，再锁屏 60 秒后返回。两次都核对同一对话和草稿。
⑤ 问“你是谁”，查看首条回答。⑥ 问“你能做啥”，查看能力说明。⑦ 问“北京三日游”，核对第 1 至第 3 天都有具体安排。第 ⑤ 至 ⑦ 项分别从新对话开始。
每项记下大概时间。遇到失败请截图，在“问题记录”里点“复制”，提供已有记录。保留当前账号、消息和草稿。
en: ① Leave an unsent draft in an existing chat. Force-quit and reopen the app, then check that the same chat, messages and draft return. ② Start a new chat, ask “Is Beijing the capital of China?” and wait for a complete reply.

③ Open both the original chat and the new chat from step ② in History. ④ Leave an unsent draft in the chat from step ②. Return after backgrounding for 10 seconds, then again after locking for 60 seconds. Verify the same chat and draft both times.

⑤ Ask “Who are you?” and check the first reply. ⑥ Ask “What can you do?” and check the capabilities. ⑦ Ask “A three-day trip to Beijing” and check for concrete plans for days 1–3. Use a fresh chat for each of steps ⑤–⑦.
Note the approximate time for each step. If something fails, take a screenshot and tap Copy in Problem notes to share any existing record. Keep your current account, messages and drafts.

title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

zh: 本轮只检查一次简单北京规划，确认有完整三天安排。
行程正式保存、修改与撤销，以及全国规划仍在验证。
“记住”偏好仍需单独完成真实验收。
本轮使用系统默认字号。较大字号下仍有卡片显示或切日问题。
分段、多选探索尚未默认开启；真机弱网和锁屏至少 5 分钟的恢复仍待单独验证。
行程详情的完整无障碍检查仍未通过，尚未认定已修复。
en: For planning, this check covers one simple Beijing request and a complete three-day itinerary.
Formal itinerary saving, edits and undo, and planning across China are still being validated.
Remember preferences still requires a separate live check.
Use the system default text size. Card display or day selection can still have issues at larger sizes.
Segmented, multiple-choice exploration is not the default. Weak-network and lock-screen recovery after at least five minutes still need separate device checks.
Trip details have not yet passed their complete accessibility checks; this remains unresolved.

zh: 本版准备时，香港在线服务来源为 1ff3941e，并沿用已有账号资格和额度规则。
以上界面修正需要更新 App。这个构建不附带服务端部署。
en: At preparation, the Hong Kong service is on source 1ff3941e with the current account eligibility and allowance rules.
Install the app update to get these interface changes. This build ships without a server deployment.
